question: Where is the active volcano found in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Barren Island** is the only active volcano found in** Andaman and Nicobar, India**.

 
 
• ​It is a type of **stratovolcano** which is made up of lava, rock fragments and ash.
